## Setup/Misc.

```{r}

# Uncomment Librarys Required
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(tidycensus)
library(jsonlite)
library(httr)


# Set seed for random data creation for replication
set.seed(123)
```

## Part 1: Data Processing

```{r}
# 1) Use httr::GET to return topic information 
# using SEPT 01, 2026 as date due to 30 day Free trail restriction

url <- "https://api.census.gov/data/2021/acs/acs1/pums/variables.json"

data <- httr::GET(url)
str(data, max.level = 1)

# 2) Parse returned information for the actual article information
raw_json <- content(data, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
parsed_data <- fromJSON(raw_json)

```
